layout.description: single: the project root is one unit workspace. umbrella: the root groups nested workspaces.

artifactsDir.description: Feature artifacts live in <artifactsDir>/<feature>/; harness state in <artifactsDir>/.flow/.

packageManager.description: npm adapter: the package manager that runs scripts. Default: package.json packageManager, then the lockfile, then npm.

custom.description: Extra steps: the command runs at the workspace root when a changed file matches one of the globs (relative to the workspace root; *, ** and ? are supported).

command.description: Executable and arguments, run without a shell

codeFiles.description: File extensions counted as code for the review thresholds, such as ".java". Replaces the unit adapter's extensions when set.

broad.description: [code lines, code files]: review is required above both

deep.description: Review is required above this many code lines

policy.description: Configured command rules. The core rules (git push, verify lock, task scope, review record/waive) always apply.

pattern.description: Regular expression tested against each command segment

unitRootOnly.description: Executables that may only run with a unit workspace root as cwd

readOnlyCli.description: CLI name -> allowed subcommands; anything else is blocked

valueOptions.description: Global options that take a value, e.g. -R

docs.description: Paths from the root; {workspace} is replaced

conventions.description: Paths from the root; {workspace} is replaced

disabled.description: Hook behaviours to turn off. "session-context" stops the SessionStart core rules.
